entry.title: saying no in practice
entry.content:
A quick write-up on saying no, mostly so future me stops relearning it.

why it matters

Saying no shows up across productivity work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Optimise for the reader who shows up six months from now with no context.
  • Measure before you change anything; intuition is a poor profiler.
  • Start with the smallest thing that works, then make it boring on purpose.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

entry.title: saying no, revisited
entry.content:
I spent a while getting saying no wrong. Here is the version that works for me.

why it matters

Saying no shows up across productivity work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Start with the smallest thing that works, then make it boring on purpose.
  • The fix that survives is the one the next person can understand.
  • Most of the value is in deleting, not adding.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
